en.title: Word Count Tool (Validate Words)
en.description:
Split the string on whitespace. A word is valid if and only if it has at least 3 ASCII characters, all of its characters are English letters or digits, and it contains at least one vowel a/e/i/o/u (either case) and at least one consonant. Count the valid words.

The input/output protocol and the explicitly marked constraints added by this site were compiled by CSWork.
en.input: One line containing a string s (length 0..200000; a bound added by this site). Words are split only on whitespace characters.
en.output: Output the number of valid words.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the full approach and proof.
